semantics.inventory_policy: A baseline test absent from the run JSON is a missing_test regression.
semantics.unsupported_policy: Newly unsupported previously-discovered tests fail as coverage loss; unsupported tests becoming PASS are non-regressing; unsupported tests becoming FAIL/HUNG/XPASS/XFAIL fail closed.
semantics.xfail_policy: Any XFAIL-set change fails closed: new XFAIL, XFAIL disappearing to PASS, XFAIL becoming FAIL/HUNG/UNSUPPORTED, or non-XFAIL becoming XFAIL.
semantics.xpass_policy: New XPASS or XFAIL-to-XPASS fails closed; baseline XPASS may remain only if still listed in the accepted baseline.
